routines.semantics: Returns an active vector rotation about an arbitrary normalized axis by angle radians. Nonunit/scaled axes are accepted; a zero axis or zero angle yields identity. Output is row-major.

scenarios.observes: axisar converts axis-angle form to rotation matrix; the actual raw return is copied into StepOutput.value, preserving all named fields or every vector/matrix entry and dimensions. Python calls the same SpiceyPy routine directly; matrix conversions only change nested/flat row-major representation.

axisar: nonunit general axis; observe every returned field/component with live SpiceyPy; the actual raw return is copied into StepOutput.value, preserving all named fields or every vector/matrix entry and dimensions. Python calls the same SpiceyPy routine directly; matrix conversions only change nested/flat row-major representation.

axisar: zero axis and angle; observe every returned field/component with live SpiceyPy; the actual raw return is copied into StepOutput.value, preserving all named fields or every vector/matrix entry and dimensions. Python calls the same SpiceyPy routine directly; matrix conversions only change nested/flat row-major representation.

routines.edgeAssessment: axisar: nonunit general axis; observe every returned field/component with live SpiceyPy; axisar: zero axis and angle; observe every returned field/component with live SpiceyPy. Every allocation-failure position for this WASM helper is covered by direct rollback tests.
routines.errorAssessment: NAIF documents the routine as error-free for correctly shaped finite inputs; no manufactured CSPICE error scenario. Axis modulo behavior and zero-axis behavior are successes, not errors, where applicable. Wrapper allocation failures are tested directly and kept distinct from live numeric CSPICE parity.
routines.fixtureRationale: No kernels/files or external scientific data. New numeric vectors, angles, matrices, and spheroid examples are authored mathematical test inputs.
routines.cleanup: No persistent kernel state or handles acquired. Native inputs/results use stack arrays with the CSPICE mutex. WASM mallocChecked rolls back all prior pointers if allocation returns zero, and successful allocation groups free in reverse order in finally, including SPICE errors. Direct failure-injection tests cover every allocation position; geodetic errors recover in the same backend instance. The parity test disposes clients in finally and case runners clear/reset state.
routines.tolerance: Retains 1e-12 absolute-or-relative comparison. All fields/entries and dimensions are compared; nonsymmetric matrices distinguish transpose/layout/order. General angles produce order-one trigonometric values; near-zero polar components use the existing absolute tolerance. No tolerance relaxation or direction/orthonormality normalization hides results.
